sectors.ai: Buy selectively into coal and nickel names with proven cost curves (ADMR, INDY, INCO) as thermal coal prices stabilize above $120/t and nickel pig iron margins recover on Indonesian ore quota tightening. Government social-spending programs and Ramadan-led consumption cycles are creating recurring, predictable demand spikes that favor companies with strong rural and semi-urban distribution networks.
sectors.ai: Buy dips in mid-cap consumer names with confirmed earnings momentum (ENZO, PADA, MBTO) as the IDX consumer aggregate holds a normal signal; the +1.01% local outperformance vs US confirms domestic demand resilience. Rotate into ESTI and MERI for catch-up, but trim OASA and UDNG on froth. Position for Q3 volume recovery in staples and discretionary snacks.
